title: AffineOpenHigherDirectImageSectionsIso
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. For an affine open $U\subset S$, a quasi-coherent module $M$ on $X$ [pqf-def-coherent], and $p\in\mathbf N$, there is an isomorphism of abelian groups $R^p\Gamma(f^{-1}U,-)(M)\cong\Gamma(U,R^p f_*M)$. The section functor and ordinary right derived functors are [def-sc-open-module-cohomology, def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image].

source.place: Tag 01XK, together with Tag 01XJ (1) and Cohomology Tags 01E1, 01E4 and 01F4 (2)

proof.text: Set V=f inverse U, N=M restricted to V and g=f restricted to U. Mathlib gives affineness of U, quasi-coherence of N and qcqs for g by open base change. The affine higher-direct-image cohomology vanishing lemma supplies every vanishing column needed by the existing Leray degeneration theorem. Its degree p edge at N is consequently invertible.

The open module cohomology comparison identifies R^p Gamma(V)(M) with the Ext-model H^p of N on V. Compose with the inverse ordinary module/source comparison to identify this group with the additive group underlying moduleCohomology(V,p)(N).

Apply the higher-direct-image open-restriction isomorphism, take global sections on U and forget scalars. Mathlib restrictAppIso at top followed by the presheaf map of U.ι_image_top identifies those sections with original sections on U. Compose the source isomorphism, the invertible Leray edge, the mapped restriction isomorphism and the section isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01XK via Leray degeneration, with open restriction Tags 01E1 and 01E5; source-model comparisons Tags 03FD and 01E1

mathlib_searches.results: No Mathlib statement. Source DirectImage.Sections has a local bound for one fixed module with IsSeparated, not a bound uniform in all modules under QuasiSeparated. Its section comparison also assumes IsSeparated. Projective has the entire arbitrary-base-change uniform bound but its import reaches this item. Neither new statement duplicates those signatures. Blueprint searches uniform local and 01XK found no matching node.

theorem nonempty_affineOpen_higherDirectImage_sections_iso
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (U : S.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (hM : M.IsQuasicoherent)
    (p : ℕ) :
    Nonempty
      ((((RingedSpace.openModuleSections X.toRingedSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)).rightDerived p).obj M) ≅
        (RingedSpace.openModuleSections S.toRingedSpace U).obj
          (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived p).obj M))
